name: core-fix-loop-spent-its-attempts
query:
wi_4d8a1c77 (the search-service "Typo tolerance" item) went needs_human. why, and how do we get it going?

`kraft view show wi_4d8a1c77 --json`:
{"id": "wi_4d8a1c77", "status": "needs_human", "current_node": "verification", "pending_gate": null}
`kraft view events wi_4d8a1c77 --type work_item_needs_human`:
{"type": "work_item_needs_human", "node": "verification", "reason": "fix loop spent its attempts", "tags": ["capped"], "detail": {"cycles": 3, "attempts": 6}}
`kraft view logs wi_4d8a1c77 -n 60` (tail):
FAILED tests/test_fuzzy.py::test_max_edit_distance - assert 3 == 2
(the same assertion failed in each of the last three attempts; the code compares `distance <= limit + 1`)
expected_behavior: Reads the stop with `kraft view show`, `kraft view events --type work_item_needs_human` and `kraft view logs -n 60` (or the tool equivalents)
States in one sentence the node (verification), the cause (the fix loop spent its attempts, tag capped, 3 cycles of 6 attempts), and that this is a retry route
Proposes retry_work_item(steer=...) with a steer that names what to change (the `limit + 1` comparison in the fuzzy matcher and test_max_edit_distance)
Waits for the person to say retry before calling retry_work_item, and does not call skip_work_item

name: trap-retry-a-budget-stop
expected_behavior: Identifies the stop as a spend cap (tag budget, $20.12 against a $20.00 cap), not a defect and not a blip
Says retrying only spends again, and routes to raising the cap with raise_budget or `kraft item raise-budget`, which the person decides
Does not call retry_work_item or skip_work_item in this turn
Asks the person for the new cap (or none) before calling raise_budget

name: boundary-config-problem-goes-to-check
expected_behavior: Names the cause as an unresolved chain, the undeclared component `link_checker` in library.yaml, at node spec
Routes it to kraft:check (a config problem), and not to kraft:doctor since the server itself is up
Does not call retry_work_item, since retrying reruns the same failure
Does not call skip_work_item, which is the person's decision
